purpose: Implement a bounded append-only Host Shadow over the exact current DAW-00B workspace observation so verified human/N0TE/external technical changes can be represented without silently mutating canonical Song memory, with FULL versus INCREMENTAL coverage preventing stale partial observations from masquerading as a current workspace model.

lineage.outcome: N0TE can truthfully say what verified technical state it currently knows about a workspace, including human-made changes, and can expose EMPTY or STALE instead of planning from obsolete host state.
lineage.capability: Bounded verified Host Shadow and human-change ledger

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 canonical SQLite and Activity chronology
legacy_rejections: single-field refresh laundering stale workspace state
human edits ignored because N0TE did not execute them
actor identity used as truth ranking
Ableton ProjectGraph vocabulary as universal owner

completion_proof: Host Shadow is EMPTY before any verified FULL baseline
verified FULL baseline produces CURRENT and defines the complete bounded projection for that workspace observation
INCREMENTAL changes are accepted only after a FULL baseline for the same current workspace observation
a later FULL resets omitted facts instead of carrying them forward from older baselines
workspace move/recovery or runtime observation change makes prior shadow STALE
STALE shadow refuses incremental refresh until a fresh FULL baseline is recorded
fresh FULL after a workspace/runtime observation change restores CURRENT
HUMAN, N0TE and EXTERNAL actor/evidence attribution is retained without actor priority semantics
TRACK, CLIP_REGION, DEVICE_PLUGIN, AUTOMATION, ROUTING, TEMPO, MARKER and TRANSPORT facts use SET/REMOVE canonical JSON events
workspace isolation, append-only SQL history, Activity journaling and restart validation hold
repeated projection/history/current reads write zero rows
Host Shadow writes no evidence claims, Song truth or Creative Twin state
